result.reason: The redline does not match the fallback because it permits both parties—including Vendor—to assign to affiliates without consent, whereas the fallback requires consent for assignments other than to successors. It also leaves Section 3(c)'s separate written-authorization requirement operative and unresolved; the margin comment cannot make that provision subject to Section 3(d). The drafting of Section 3(d) is otherwise clear and does not alter unrelated restrictions on transfer, lease, export, or sublicensing.
